JOYSTAR Beachside Cruiser Bike - 20" 24" 26"
Embrace the breeze with the JOYSTAR Beachside Cruiser. Combining a classic silhouette with effortless functionality, this cruiser is designed for casual neighborhood loops, beach boardwalks, and scenic commutes. Available in multiple sizes to fit everyone from growing youth to adults.

Timeless coastal vibes: The JOYSTAR Beachside in its element.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted for simplicity and relaxation, the Beachside features a robust step-through frame and intuitive braking for a stress-free riding experience."
Relaxed Geometry & Control
The JOYSTAR Beachside is engineered with Hi-Tensile Steel for a sturdy, vibration-dampening ride. Its single-speed drivetrain keeps maintenance to a minimum, while the rear coaster brake allows you to stop simply by pedaling backward—keeping your hands free and the aesthetic clean.

Low-maintenance single-speed design for pure riding enjoyment.

Key Features & Benefits

Upright Comfort: Swept-back handlebars and an ergonomic frame design promote a healthy, upright riding posture.

Plush Seating: Equipped with an oversized, dual-spring padded saddle for maximum comfort on longer rides.

Smooth Rolling: 2.125" wide pneumatic tires provide a stable footprint and absorb bumps on paved surfaces.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Don't let tools hold you back. The JOYSTAR Beachside arrives 85% pre-assembled. We include all the necessary tools and a straightforward guide so you can hit the road in about 20 minutes.

Step-by-step: Watch how easily the Beachside comes together.

See It In Action

Experience the smooth, easy glide of the Beachside Cruiser.

Our Guarantee
We stand by our bikes so you can ride with confidence:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Your steel frame is covered for life against manufacturing defects.

2-Year Component Coverage: Major parts like forks and cranks are protected for two full years.

Dedicated Support: Access our expert customer service team for any assembly or maintenance help.
